title: My Football Player Replacement Finder
description: A full account of building Transferium Player Intelligence: every architectural decision, from choosing Neo4j over a relational database to designing a weighted cosine similarity engine that separates profile shape from absolute quality.

title: Pola — A Virtual Market of AI Shopkeepers
description: A full account of building Pola: the case for building a place instead of a chat widget, a hand-built Ghibli-style Three.js world, and a FastAPI backend that falls back across three LLM providers to run at zero hosting cost.

title: When Your Dashboards Deceive
description: An interactive essay on Goodhart's Law, the economic principle that silently corrupts KPI dashboards across every industry. Includes real case studies, a live metric simulator, and a practical framework for designing better measurements.
